name: Allylnorpethidine
summary: Allylnorpethidine (WIN-7681) is a 4-phenylpiperidine derivative that is related to the opioid analgesic drug pethidine (meperidine).

pharmacology.text: In many other opioid derivatives, placing an allyl substituent on the nitrogen instead of a methyl will reverse the normal opioid effects, to produce μ-opioid antagonists which among other things reverse the respiratory depression caused by opioid agonists such as morphine.

uses.en: It is a research compound and has never been sold as a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，從未作為藥物販售。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，从未作为药物贩售。

fact.en: In many opioids, swapping the methyl group on the nitrogen for an allyl group turns the drug into a blocker, which is how nalorphine was made from morphine. Allylnorpethidine is pethidine with this same swap.
fact.zh: 在許多鴉片類藥物中，把氮原子上的甲基換成烯丙基會讓藥物變成阻斷劑，nalorphine 就是這樣從嗎啡改造而來。Allylnorpethidine 則是對配西汀做了同樣的替換。
fact.zhHans: 在许多鸦片类药物中，把氮原子上的甲基换成烯丙基会让药物变成阻断剂，nalorphine 就是这样从吗啡改造而来。Allylnorpethidine 则是对配西汀做了同样的替换。
